posts.summary: Interactive CRF event calendar connected to remote event data through a PHP/JSON integration.
posts.skills:

posts.content:
CRF Calendar was an interactive event-calendar application developed for the Cardiovascular Research Foundation.

The front end requested calendar data by date range, transformed the returned JSON into calendar entries, supported month and year navigation, and assembled event-detail modal content dynamically with JavaScript and jQuery.

A PHP endpoint used cURL to request public calendar-event data from CRF/TCTMD and returned that response to the browser, separating the remote service request from the client-side calendar interface.
